title: platanthera × andrewsii
intro: Platanthera × andrewsii, commonly known as the hybrid bog orchid, is a rare, self-pollinating orchid species resulting from the natural crossing of Platanthera leucophaea and Platanthera dilatata. The plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antiseptic effects. Its therapeutic actions include wound healing, antimicrobial, and antifungal properties, which make it useful in treating various skin conditions and infections. The bioactive constituents of Platanthera × andrewsii have been found to include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
